title: Sylvester Chatwell
subtitle: Your own household butler in Grok Bot

steps.title: Get Grok Bot
steps.detail: Buy Grok Premium (x.ai/pricing). Get the Grok Bot app at x.ai/bot and sign in

steps.title: Create your butler
steps.detail: Create a Bot named Sylvester and send: “Set yourself up from github.com/OneManMobile/sylvester-chatwell”

steps.title: Connect nemlig.com
steps.detail: He opens a login page. Tap Take over, type your password, tap Log in, then I’m done

steps.title: Tell him how you eat
steps.detail: A few short questions: who eats, diet and allergies, staples, pizza night?

steps.title: Ask for next week’s meal plan
steps.detail: “Make next week’s meal plan and fill my basket.” He never orders – you tap Bestil

bonus.title: Ask for a recipe card
bonus.detail: For any day of the plan – kitchen-ready
